title: Enallage
summary: ENAL'LAGE, noun enal'lajy. [Gr. change.] A figure, in grammar, by which some change is made in the common mode of speech, or when one word is substituted for another; as exercitus victor, for victorio

inlines.v: ENAL'LAGE, noun enal'lajy. [Gr. change.] A figure, in grammar, by which some change is made in the common mode of speech, or when one word is substituted for another; as exercitus victor, for victoriousus; scelus, for scelestus.
